messages:
tara (marketing): Heads-up: aiming to publish the Alpha release post tomorrow 10:05am PT. Need final changelog link, docs anchor, webinar window (30-45m), a short benchmark blurb for the post, and instructions for routing incoming leads. Engineering: canary timing? changelog pointer?

josh (eng): Canary plan: start 9:30am PT, 20% for 15m, then promote to 100% if stable. Will add changelog draft now at https://redwood.dev/changelog/alpha-rc1 (update).

leo (docs): Draft docs live at https://docs.redwood.dev/alpha. I added a quickstart + curl/node snippets but will shorten the example to keep the announcement under 200 words. Point to docs#quickstart anchor.

rachel (product): Suggested hero copy: "Alpha: predictable, low-latency inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Webinar CTA idea: "Register to see a live demo & perf deep-dive."

devon (sales): Routing plan: tag webinar signups with `lead.source:alpha_webinar` and push to SF AE queue. Also create a Dedicated-interest nurture path. I can wire Intercom once you confirm the tag names.

josh (eng): Changelog updated w/ rollout notes and rollback steps: https://redwood.dev/changelog/alpha-rc1. Rollout snippet for ops:

```
rollout:
  mode: canary
  initial_percent: 20
  watch_period: 15m
  promote_on: success
  fallback_to: model-v1
```

If p95 > 300ms for >3m auto-fallback.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by josh for 2024-06-18T09:30:00-07:00. CI green. :rocket:

leo (docs): I published the trimmed quickstart at https://docs.redwood.dev/alpha#quickstart. Please link the announcement to that anchor, not the root.

tara (marketing): Great. Devon, please add the Intercom rule and confirm. Rachel, can you finalize two headline variants (short + long) and the 1-sentence subhead by 5pm PT?

rachel (product): Short: "Redwood Alpha: Fast, predictable LLM inference". Long: "Redwood Alpha: unified inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments with canary rollouts and observability". Subhead: "Launch includes reserved canaries, rollout fallbacks, and docs to get started." Dropping these into the draft.

devon (sales): Intercom rule created and tested. Leads flow into SF with tag alpha_webinar and campaign=alpha_launch. Dedicated interest autolabel set.

josh (eng): Canary kicked at 9:30. Early perf: p50 115ms, p95 270ms. No anomalies so far. Monitoring traces and infra dashboards.

tara (marketing): Well schedule the blog to go live 10:05am PT (announce after canary is steady). Bench narrative for the post: call out p50/p95 vs baseline, explain batching + KV cache impact, then CTA to webinar. Keep bench paragraph to ~3 sentences.

rachel (product): Webinar agenda: 1) quick product TL;DR, 2) live demo (20m), 3) benchmark deep-dive (15m), 4) Q&A (10m). Suggest panel: product + eng + docs.

josh (eng): I can prepare a short perf trace and sample prompts for the demo. Ping me if ops needs exports.

leo (docs): Uploaded the final example code and screenshot to the docs page. Link again: https://docs.redwood.dev/alpha#quickstart.

tara (marketing): Final checklist: changelog -> https://redwood.dev/changelog/alpha-rc1; docs -> https://docs.redwood.dev/alpha#quickstart; webinar slot confirmed; lead routing in place. Everyone good to publish at 10:05? :thumbsup:

josh (eng): :thumbsup:

leo (docs): :thumbsup:

rachel (product): :thumbsup:

devon (sales): :thumbsup:

tara (marketing): I'll post the announcement copy in this thread 30 minutes before publish for a last sanity check. Thanks!
